    Then LOV-CAPABILITY, LOV-EVENT and LOV-SCOPE are read at the version in force through DP-07
    Then an access entry is retained under the decision log's retention rule
    Then the repository of the search has no connection to rwb_decision

  Scenario: AC7 A caller without a session is refused 401 and a path the contract does not provide is 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the request carries no session
    When the caller calls GET /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/access-log with from 2026-11-16 and to 2026-11-22
    Then the response is 401 with message MSG-P4-001
    When the caller calls a path that API-P4-008 does not provide
    Then the response is 404
